identificationModule.briefTitle: Octreotide Acetate and Recombinant Interferon Alfa-2b or Bevacizumab in Treating Patients With Metastatic or Locally Advanced, High-Risk Neuroendocrine Tumor
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Prospective Randomized Comparison of Depot Octreotide Plus Interferon Alpha Versus Depot Octreotide Plus Bevacizumab (NSC #704865) in Advanced, Poor Prognosis Carcinoid Patients

armGroups.label: Arm I (octreotide acetate and bevacizumab)
armGroups.description: Patients receive depot octreotide acetate IM and bevacizumab IV over 30-90 minutes on day 1. Treatment repeats every 21 days in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm II (octreotide acetate and recombinant interferon alfa-2b)
armGroups.description: Patients receive octreotide acetate IM as in arm I on day 1 and recombinant interferon alfa-2b SC on days 1, 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 17, and 19. Treatment repeats every 21 days in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
